# Synthetic document fixtures
Authored by `scripts/create_document_fixtures.py`; no user or upstream copyrighted examples. SourcePack MIT licence applies. The script uses optional document authoring libraries, not required by the core runtime.

- policy.docx / policy.pdf: retry limit seven; human review.
- handoff.pptx: manual review on slide 1; approved library handoff on slide 2.
- budgets.xlsx: Budgets sheet; Reader required with budget 7; OCR optional.
- scan.pdf: image-only manual review setting. Text extraction alone must report its limitation.
